Krab is a SaaS and Fintech startup that enables truckers/trucking companies with no formal credit score to access loans from banks.

The company was founded in 2020 and based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 40 (-12).
